definition: One point per completed logged decode binding revision and selected slot/task set. Context is combined history at entry. Throughput divides combined emitted tokens by the interval after the binding is active until its completion boundary. Activation/rebinding and prefill time are excluded. Scheduling, sampling and pipeline gaps inside the active interval remain included. Internal resident/ring repartitions are not separately logged.

smoothing.range: each parallelism observed context-entry range; no extrapolation

uncertainty: Cancellation-adjacent estimates are hollow diamonds. Completion boundaries have up to one verification block of attribution uncertainty.
scope: All completed decode bindings in the production launch, including smoke probes and other traffic; not restricted to one Hermes task. Captured before temporary GPU-test pauses; later code is not represented by this source revision.
